sourceScopes: qtbase: installed upstream SPDX identifies source notices; it is not a final launcher link inventory.
qtsvg: installed upstream SPDX identifies source notices; it is not a final launcher link inventory.
QtImageFormats/WebP legal texts match the original source; installed QWebp build/SPDX/final-link binding remains required.
libarchive COPYING identifies separately licensed files; complete per-file and final-link review is still required.
The prefix also contains an import-library/DLL; installed library names do not prove an entirely static final executable.
liblzma is 0BSD; the complete xz source archive also includes LGPL/GPL tools and build materials.
builderRequirements: Only the builder owns generated TrustedLauncherBuild.hpp and production RCDATA.
Embed notice original bytes exactly and independently extract/hash them from the formal executable.
Bind source_set_sha256 to the actual CMake codemodel source inventory; this notice digest is not the source digest.
Keep trusted_launcher_ready false until final application/source/object/library/relink evidence is accepted.
NOASSERTION and the Pd project-use instruction do not provide an unrecorded independent artwork redistribution grant.
provenanceKindCorrection: Original material kind is recorded separately from its approved read-only provenance; notice bytes and notice-set digest are unchanged.
